reviews.comment: Professor Yu was amazing! Her class was pretty easy and mostly a routine of read-discuss-repeat. There are a lot of readings, but the discussions were always fun and interesting. I would definitely recommend this class if you're a non-English major looking for a chill and interesting literature credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Ms. Yu is a wonderful prof. The assignments were very manageable and the only only homework was to read the texts for class. She is incredibly passionate about the topics which is nice. A large amount of the grade is participation, which was graded rather leniently. I highly recommend her if you're looking for a relaxed, low-stress ENGL prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring
